scripts.test: for service in auth import export db-service email; do (cd $service && npm test) || exit 1; done
scripts.test:typecheck: for service in auth import export db-service email; do (cd $service && npm run test:typecheck) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: for service in auth import export db-service email; do (cd $service && npm run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:typecheck && npm test && npm run build
